verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents a REST API covering deals, people, companies, activities and documents, and publishes a live OpenAPI spec and an llms.txt, so the CRM can be driven programmatically without the UI. There is no evidence of a CLI, a headless runner, or CI-specific guidance, so headless use is limited to scripting against the API. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless mode, documented CI/automation workflows (e.g. token auth for non-interactive runs, sandbox/test environment), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
